subject: Genomics OOD - resourcing and budget
body:
Viktor,

Compute and staffing picture as promised. The LSTM sweeps (hidden size, background-model mutation rate) are cheap per run but wide - I want ~64 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort through May, then a small reserved slice for the June eval push. Staffing: Nikhil 80%, Yara 50%, Halima 40%. No external asks.

On budget: Idris, our finance partner, has verbally earmarked $120k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-44 for this project. I am planning the June/July reserved runs against that line, so flag me if anything moves before the paperwork lands.

One dependency: the before-2011 train and 2011-2016 validation splits need re-hosting on Corpus before we scale runs. Halima is on it this week.

Deshawn
